title: Run one real resumable E0-to-projection Shadow through the top-level CLI
summary: A8 cannot produce an architecture-v2.1-compliant real resumable E0-to-projection Shadow without changing frozen upstream work or inventing an unversioned ingest contract. Completion is therefore refused.

evidence: 01_调度器/mode_p_vnext/domain/projection.py defines the A1 canonical ProjectionAST, ProjectionManifest, ProjectionNode, and CapabilityAdaptationRecord.
01_调度器/mode_p_vnext/services/projection_compiler.py independently defines differently shaped ProjectionAST, ProjectionManifest, and ProjectionNode classes.
01_调度器/mode_p_vnext/adapters/delivery/capability.py independently defines a differently shaped CapabilityAdaptationRecord.
Runtime identity checks returned ProjectionAST_same=False and CapabilityRecord_same=False.
01_调度器/mode_p_vnext/domain/artifact.py requires the exact canonical domain ProjectionAST type for ArtifactKind.PROJECTION_AST.
findings.root_cause: A6 was accepted with service and adapter data classes that duplicate A1-frozen canonical domain authority.
findings.impact: A8 cannot persist A6 projection output in the canonical ArtifactEnvelope and cannot satisfy ADR-016 exclusive ownership.
findings.required_recovery: Invalidate A6 and its dependants through ReleaseLedger, then repair A6 to construct and consume only mode_p_vnext.domain.projection types before revalidating A7 and reclaiming A8.

evidence: 01_调度器/mode_p_vnext/adapters/storage/shadow_layout.py emits only line:NNNN facts for arbitrary non-empty script lines.
01_调度器/mode_p_vnext/services/vec_assembler.py derives references only from char_, prop_, costume_, and scene_ fact-id prefixes and derives audio only from dialogue_ facts.
The v2.1 architecture bundle does not freeze a typed script-ingest encoding that defines speaker, dialogue, character, wardrobe, prop, setting, scope, or provenance mapping for arbitrary scripts.
findings.root_cause: A5 and the A8 draft depend on incompatible, undocumented fact-id conventions; the canonical FactRegistry records FactKind but not the semantic subtypes required by VEC assembly.
findings.impact: An unknown script can reach VEC assembly with zero reference requirements and missing dialogue audio, so the required real vertical path is not deterministic or schema-complete.
findings.required_recovery: Version an architecture amendment that defines the typed INGEST-to-FactRegistry contract and its validation ownership, then rebase affected task contracts before implementation.

evidence: The untracked A8 episode_nodes.py, scene_nodes.py, and adapters/storage files are not wired into the top-level CLI.
findings.root_cause: The A8 draft added disconnected helpers instead of one top-level persistent execution graph.
findings.impact: The registered A8 entry does not perform E0, S1, K1, B0, K2, B1, VEC, Gate 0, DP, or dual projection.
findings.required_recovery: After upstream recovery, implement one CLI-owned RunSession and NodeRunner graph covering the complete architecture-v2.1 state path.

evidence: Both A8 _signature helpers construct StageSignature without approved_input_fields, output_semantics, output_exclusions, prompt_budget, or schema_budget.
Direct runtime probes for E0 and B0 raised TypeError before any provider call.
findings.root_cause: A8 reconstructs A4 signatures instead of consuming the frozen stage_signatures registry.
findings.impact: No real E0 or B0 call can start.
findings.required_recovery: Use stage_signatures()[Stage.E0/S1/B0/B1] without local signature reconstruction.

evidence: The A8 candidate does not use A2 RunSession, NodeRunner, ArtifactEnvelope, checkpoint state, or content-addressed ArtifactStore.
ShadowRunRecord writes record_sha256 but read_run_record does not validate it.
resolve_run_id hashes raw bytes while ingest_script hashes decoded and re-encoded text, permitting newline or BOM-dependent identity divergence.
findings.root_cause: A separate run-record format was introduced instead of integrating the A2 persistent runtime.
findings.impact: Accepted nodes cannot be proven reusable, corrupted records can be accepted, and run identity is not portable.
findings.required_recovery: Reuse A2 persistence and canonical normalized hashing; verify every stored digest before resume.

evidence: The registered test file 01_调度器/mode_p_vnext/tests/test_a8_real_shadow.py does not exist.
No executable A8 evidence proves single_real_cli_entry, accepted_nodes_not_recalled, no_golden_vec_injection, or text_validated_claim_ceiling end to end.
findings.root_cause: Implementation was left at disconnected draft stage before its acceptance suite was created.
findings.impact: A8 has no admissible completion evidence.
findings.required_recovery: Create the registered end-to-end and adversarial tests only after the upstream contracts are repaired.
